The Government of Indonesia  has received financing in the amount of US$ 10,000,000 equivalent from the World Bank toward the cost of the Indonesia Disaster Risk Finance & Insurance, and it intends to apply part of the proceeds to payments for goods, works, non-consulting services and consulting services to be procured under this project.

 

The project will include the following:

Component 2: Improving Preparedness for More Effective Disaster Response Across Government Agencies.

This component will support MOF to build the disbursement channels for resources from the PFB to flow efficiently, effectively, and transparently. This will be achieved through actions that streamline processes and set up programs to quickly allocate and disburse funds to relevant ministries and agencies to be used through existing government systems for enhanced preparedness, response, and rehabilitation. Specifically, this will include the following activities: (i) Budget tracking to strengthen disaster related fiscal effectiveness; (ii) Supporting disaster preparedness and early action; (iii) Supporting subnational governments in disaster preparedness and response; (iv) Supporting faster social assistance payments for disaster victims through Adaptive Social Protection; (v) Supporting improved health preparedness and response to disasters.

 

Component 3: Strengthening PFB capacity and systems to effectively support risk finance and disaster response.

This component will support MoF to achieve the PBCs and associated results under Component 1 and Component 2.

Objective A; The purpose of this Statement of Work (SOW) is to establish a Base Period plus Four (4) Option Periods contract for the REPLACEMENT of three (3) as like generators for operational readiness of GWMP-owned emergency generators. The Contractor shall replace as like and shall perform inspections, testing, adjustments, and preventive maintenance services to ensure generators remain in a reliable state of readiness to provide uninterrupted emergency power. OR B; The objective of this Statement of Work (SOW) is to establish a Base Period plus Four (4) Option Periods contract for the REPAIR, inspection, preventive maintenance, testing, and operational readiness of existing GWMP-owned emergency generators. fter hour repairs, consumable parts and ﬂuids. corrective repairs, replacement of defective or worn components, ongoing operational monitoring, and bi-annual load bank testing to verify system reliability and performance.
